table ip vpnrelay {
	chain pre {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		iifname "eth0" tcp dport 443 counter packets 918273 bytes 61234567 dnat to 150.251.152.243:443
		iifname "eth0" udp dport 443 counter packets 5521 bytes 4410021 dnat to 150.251.152.243:443
	}

	chain post {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		oifname "eth0" ip daddr 150.251.152.243 ct status dnat counter packets 923794 bytes 65644588 masquerade
	}

	chain relayfwd {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
		tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size set rt mtu
		ct state established,related accept
		ct status dnat ip daddr 150.251.152.243 accept
		counter packets 0 bytes 0
	}
}
